caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a colored illustration at its center, bordered by a decorative and inscribed rim. The plate contains two male figures standing side by side, both facing forward. Each figure is wearing a colonial-style outfit consisting of knee-length coats, waistcoats, breeches, and black shoes with stockings. Both men have black tricorn hats and are outlined in dark brown or black. The figure on the left is dressed in a coat with orange or reddish-brown coloring, while the figure on the right has a lighter, possibly yellowish coat. The background of the plate is a pale cream or off-white color with brown and orange decorative details, including heart and floral motifs. Around the rim, there is an inscription in a script that appears to be German, along with the year “1781” written on the left side. The drawing is set against a tan or light brown paper with the words “Drawn to actual size - Elmer C. Anderson” written below the plate. The entire scene is depicted on a tilted square background, making the plate appear to sit on a diamond-shaped field.
title: Pa. German Pie Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
